dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth and continuous 2D geometric narrowing from the maximum mid-body width toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single prominent dark circular focal point on the anterior-left dorsal quadrant and a faint longitudinal linear mark along the posterior dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark circular mark (likely a lesion or unique pigmentation) on the upper-left flank and a thin longitudinal scar or marking visible along the mid-to-posterior dorsal axis.
